status: Finite V3 development search complete; proceed with locked selected models and all controls
source_comparisons: 12families,3broad development chromosome folds,3fixed seeds per neural family,126independent R metric replays; prior V1/V2/native-weight experiments preserved
basis: Learned DNA+AVI combination improved individual-variant development ranking across both studies, addressing the main activity-only gain concern. No additional architecture will be selected using reserved results.
backbone_scope: Final source DNA encoder/PWMs are fixed; neural context/contrast heads trained by backprop and combination coefficients trained from source assays. The older native-weight fine-tune did not outperform its comparators; this does not prove native fine-tuning could never help new data.
remaining_limitations: Finite search cannot establish global optimality or disease prediction. Independent studies/donors, source foundation-model exposure, patient outcomes and causal target genes remain unresolved.
